title: bumelia glomerata subsp. horrida
intro: Bumelia glomerata subsp. horrida, commonly known as the Thorny Bumelia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bumelia glomerata subsp. horrida include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as triterpenes and phenolic compounds. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its benefits and potential applications.
